verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents MFA for application users, with enrollment, challenge and verify flows and app-level enforcement guidance. It also documents enterprise SAML 2.0 SSO for project end-users with Okta, Entra/AD, Google Workspace and Auth0. Together these cover the core of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of enterprise OIDC SSO (only SAML is documented; OIDC appears only as social login), detail on how MFA/SSO is enforced as mandatory (described only as app-level guidance), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
